description: Research r8 (dev only): r5 a01_fp32_lr1e-6_skip_cos_mal0 (A 001 + fp32 master weights at lr 1e-6, cosine decay to 1e-7 over the 290-min budget, zero-advantage rows skipped, training reward 0 for malformed or truncated outputs) with the verifier's -0.1 for malformed outputs from step 300 on (malformed_reward_until 300). r5 searched and reached 0.355-0.380 by step 300, then truncation crept up (training batches 0.44 -> 0.75 truncated), the informative groups vanished and all three seeds collapsed after steps 350-550; skip_cos (-0.1 throughout) mostly went one-guess within 30 min. The switch keeps r5's early search and penalizes truncation once the policy has learned to search. Final weights are saved for dev-ladder sampler evals.
